package_claude_md.quote: Instead of loading them at launch, Claude Code loads each one once Claude reads, writes, or edits another file in that subdirectory.

claude_md_excludes.quote: You can configure `claudeMdExcludes` at any settings layer: user, project, local, or managed policy. Arrays merge across layers.

deny_read.quote: add `Read` deny rules in `permissions.deny` to block Claude from opening those files.

enabled_plugins.quote: Project settings: plugins turned on for everyone in the repository. This doesn't install them, so each user installs them.

code_intelligence.quote: It doesn't include the language server.

sparse_paths.quote: Include `.claude` in the list so that each worktree also has the repository's `.claude/settings.json` and `.claude/rules/`.

symlink_directories.quote: Symlink directories from the main repository into each worktree so you don't duplicate large directories on disk.

worktree_ignore.quote: By default, the worktree is created under `.claude/worktrees/<name>/` ... Add `.claude/worktrees/` to your `.gitignore`

package_settings.quote: Project settings in `.claude/settings.json` aren't inherited from parent directories the way CLAUDE.md files are.

additional_directories.quote: Directories listed in `permissions.additionalDirectories` in a settings file grant file access only and don't load any of the configuration below.

plan_survives.quote: The plan Claude wrote in plan mode / Re-injected from disk
